title: The jersey
logline: A high-school jersey the shop shadow-boxed in 2006, on a den wall in 2024 above a recliner, the number reserved, the box's glass dusty. The kid is forty. The recliner is his. He isn't in it.

panels.composition: A den wall with a shadow-boxed high-school jersey above an empty recliner, the box's glass dusty, a television's blue light from the side, the jersey's number obscured by the glare.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a den wall with a shadow-boxed high school jersey above an empty recliner, the box's glass dusty and its number lost in glare, blue television light from the side, no people, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The kid is forty. The recliner empty.
